description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for a wizard process, including options parsing, error handling, network communication with a gateway, and user interaction for wizard steps. It orchestrates the wizard's execution flow, manages WebSocket communication with a gateway, and provides user prompts based on wizard step types.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An actor class managing WebSocket connection, authentication, and request-response cycle with a gateway server for wizard operations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WizardCliOptions struct.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the wizard process based on command-line options, including establishing a WebSocket connection and handling wizard steps.

methods.name: resolveWizardGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the WebSocket endpoint URL based on options and configuration.

methods.name: runWizard
methods.description: Executes the wizard flow, interacting with the user and the gateway client to progress through wizard steps.
